title: executive-daily-priority-scratchpad-noah-2026-03-14.json
content:
Daily scratchpad - Noah Kim - 2026-03-14

Top of mind / weekly goals (week of Mar 9-15)
- Finalize Dedicated capacity pricing tier proposal for sales review (target: Thu 3/19). Need updated unit economics from finance.
- Greenlight private deployment pilot with Acme Health (legal flags cleared?). Confirm infra checklist and NDA.
- Reduce p50 hosted API latency to <= 85ms by end of week; coordinate infra + serving-runtime changes.
- Ship rollout plan for model quantization experiment (A/B + fallback) - product + SRE signoff.

Meetings today / prep notes
1) 9:00am - Exec standup (15m)
   - Quick status: Dedicated pricing draft, Acme pilot, latency work.
   - Ask: Any blockers from GTM or Legal?
2) 10:30am - Infra & Serving runtime sync (30m) w/ Priya, Harini
   - Agenda: kernel selection rollout timeline, perf regression risk matrix, canary schedule for enabling continuous batching.
   - Prep: confirm perf benchmark slides (p50/p95 current vs baseline). Ask SLO impact if we change batching policy.
3) 1:00pm - Sales briefing (45m) w/ Alex & SalesOps
   - Topic: Dedicated offering terms, early adopter discounts, commit levels. Bring a one-pager with commit tiers and expected latency guarantees.
4) 3:00pm - Legal + Privacy check (30m) for Acme Health pilot
   - Items: data residency, KMS integration, audit log retention (90 days vs 365). Confirm support for HSM option.

Follow-ups / action items (quick, assign, due)
- Ask Finance (Ravi): updated unit economics for Dedicated v2 (cost/GPU, expected utilization targets) - due 2026-03-17.
- Priya: upload perf benchmark deck + raw numbers to Confluence before 10:00am. (Pinged)
- Harini: draft canary rollout steps and rollback criteria for continuous batching change - due end of day.
- Alex: draft customer-facing Dedicated pricing one-pager and send to me for review by EOD.
- Legal (Sofia): confirm NDA template + pilot MSA changes for healthcare customers; highlight any mandatory controls.

Quick metrics snapshot (as of 2026-03-13 EOD) - paste from ops slack
- Hosted API: p50 = 92ms (goal 85ms), p95 = 310ms (improved), errors < 0.05%
- Cost: avg token cost hosted = $0.013 / 1k tokens (target reduce by 15% via batching/quant)
- Dedicated: utilization across pools = 64% (target 70% next month)
- Customer health: 2 active pilots, 5 customers in onboarding, churn risk: none immediate

Parking lot / longer-term notes
- Consider adding per-route latency SLAs for high-value customers (ops + legal implications).
- Evaluate offering pre-warmed KV-cache option as add-on for low-latency apps.
- Brainstorm: developer experience checklist for Private deployments (install guide, post-install tests, security checklist).

Notes to self (scratchy)
- Remember to push benchmark updates into dashboard before infra sync.
- Re-check model rollback test coverage (unit + integration) - ensure deterministic failover in release-candidate.
- If Acme needs 365-day log retention, ask infra about cost delta.

End-of-day quick review (to fill)
- Did I unblock sales on pricing?
- Were infra benchmarks uploaded?
- Any legal blockers for pilot?

Timestamped log (quick)
- 07:45 - skim PRs for quantization runtime changes; nothing urgent.
- 08:20 - pinged Finance (Ravi) for econ numbers.
- 08:50 - drafted one-pager skeleton for pricing (will refine with Alex).
notes_short: Exec scratchpad: pricing for Dedicated, Acme Health pilot, latency SLOs, meeting prep, follow-ups, metrics snapshot.
